item.title: [PARQUET-1133] INT96 types and Maps without OriginalType cause exceptions in PigSchemaConverter
item.description:
Trying to load parquet files in Pig, that have the following causes an exception and parsing to fail:

  • INT96 fields, for example: 
    message spark_schema {
  optional int96 datetime;
}

    The Exception thrown is:

    Failed to parse: can't convert optional int96 myInt96
